newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends up on fund buying, position switch.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends up on fund buying, position switch.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended higher on commission-house buying and position-switching tied to spillover strength from the rally in CBOT grains and soy products, traders said.

"What prompted us to trade above the technical trend line was Pro Farmer's corn (production) estimate of 8.2 billion (bushels)," a KCBT trader said. "That was lower than anything we'd seen, so it set off a buying frenzy."
Traders noted that KCBT Dec wheat gained at the expense of the Sept contract as players switched their positions out of the front month ahead of first notice date for deliveries.
KCBT wheat closed one to 12 cents per bushel higher, with Sept up 2-3/4 cents at $4.85-3/4 a bushel. Dec gained 5-1/2 cents per bushel to close at $4.85-1/2.
Traders said Rosenthal Collins bought at least three million Dec bushels and Benson Quinn bought two million Dec.
General Mills and Continental Grain each bull-spread at least one million Sept/Dec bushels. Wolcott & Lincoln bear-spread one million Dec/Sept bushels, traders said.
